patches.title: Scan Adjacent Countertops First
patches.principle: When the target is not found, check nearby countertops before moving to other furniture types.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and the current surface lacks it.

patches.title: Return to Safe Start After Fail
patches.principle: If multiple containers yield no target, return to a known open surface like countertop to reorient.
patches.when_to_apply: After opening several containers without finding the target.

patches.title: Complete Clean Before New Search
patches.principle: After placing a cleaned object, do not begin searching for another until the current task is fully done.
patches.when_to_apply: When the cleaning task involves a single object and placement is confirmed.
